_doc: Which Claude Code hooks (hooks/hooks.json) omp runs through omp/hook-bridge.ts. hooks.json stays the single wiring source; this file only says which scripts are safe to run from omp and why the rest are not. Bridged hooks run with ATLAS_MANDATES=off because omp/mandates.ts owns the mandates with omp-native reachability.

notBridged.dispatch_tripwire.py: omp/index.ts implements its native-tool and naming rules natively; the inline-op tiers read Claude Code transcript paths and atlas_db events that only Claude hooks write
notBridged.todo_capture.py: omp/index.ts mirrors the omp todo tool to the board natively
notBridged.atlas_doctor.py: mines atlas_db telemetry written by Claude Code hooks
notBridged.completion_gate.py: conditions (a)-(l) read the Claude Code transcript JSONL and atlas_db run events; omp session files use a different schema (needs a transcript adapter); (m) is native in omp/index.ts
notBridged.nudge.py: keyed to Claude Code Stop payloads and transcript
notBridged.connector_credential_watch.py: its matchers name Claude MCP tools (mcp__<server>__<tool>); omp mints mcp__<server>_<tool>, so the server/tool split is not recoverable
notBridged.recall_gate.py: omp/mandates.ts implements the recall gate natively
